plan_name: Phase 12I Pilot Study Execution Package & Safeguard Architecture

domain_allocation.sampling_method: Stratified random selection across senior, mid, junior candidate pools
Targeted representation of AWS, GCP, Azure, and Kubernetes toolchains

domain_allocation.stratum: Data Science / Machine Learning / Data Engineering
domain_allocation.sampling_method: Balanced representation of ML modeling, LLM/NLP, and data platform roles
Focus on automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress)
Focus on technical scope, systems architecture, and engineering governance

scientific_safeguards.model_blind_sampling: Pairs are selected strictly based on domain stratum quotas and metadata. Zero model inferences or similarity embeddings are computed or exposed during selection.
scientific_safeguards.independent_annotation: Annotators access pairs in randomized individual task queues. No real-time chat, shared spreadsheets, or visible peer ratings.

complete_blinding.peer_ratings: Rater 1 cannot see Rater 2's rating or comments.
complete_blinding.candidate_identity: Direct PII (names, contact details, profile URLs) redacted.
complete_blinding.company_identity: Hiring organization names sanitized to generic company profiles.

scientific_safeguards.dual_sided_evidence_logging: Mandatory extraction of exact resume quote and job description quote justifying assigned label.
scientific_safeguards.original_rating_immutability: Pre-adjudication ratings logged with SHA-256 integrity hashes prior to tie-break adjudication.

pilot_quarantine_and_isolation_policy.cardinal_isolation_rule: Pilot pairs utilized for annotator training, rubric refinement, or boundary calibration are PERMANENTLY QUARANTINED and EXCLUDED from the final frozen evaluation benchmark.
pilot_quarantine_and_isolation_policy.rationale: Evaluating models on pairs that underwent subjective discussion or rubric adjustment introduces experimenter degree-of-freedom leakage and optimistic bias.
pilot_quarantine_and_isolation_policy.final_benchmark_requirement: The final evaluation benchmark (N >= 2,850 pairs) must consist exclusively of virgin pairs evaluated under the frozen, finalized Rubric V3 without interim guideline alterations.

human_annotation_readiness_status.protocol_readiness: 100% Complete (Rubric V3, Reliability Specs, Sampling Quotas, and Schemas defined)
human_annotation_readiness_status.synthetic_data_declaration: ZERO synthetic or pseudo-labels have been generated. Independent statistical evaluation will commence once human recruiters execute the blinded pilot queue.
prohibited_actions: Claiming pilot has passed before human ratings exist
Using LLMs to generate surrogate recruiter labels
Reporting empirical kappa on unannotated data
